title: Tucker and Dale vs. Evil
tagline: Two nice guys. One very bad misunderstanding.
about: Two kind hillbillies fixing up their dream cabin get taken for killers by college kids who keep dying by accident.
cue: Serve the honey chicken when Tucker saws into the beehive.
faces: “Oh hidy ho officer, we've had a doozy of a day.”

    Porch snacksCabin mainsCampfire TreatsFrom the esky
    Porch snacksLake catfish bites with comeback sauceDale pulls Allison out of the lake. Cornmeal-crusted fish bites.How to make it500g skinless basa or catfish fillets, cut in chunks250ml buttermilk100g fine cornmeal50g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika500ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauce1 lemonStir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into comeback sauce.Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika and salt.Toss the fish in the cornmeal and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp.Drain, salt and serve with the sauce and lemon.Gas station chilli dogs with cheeseDale says hi holding a scythe. Beef franks smothered in chilli and cheddar.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls300g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced1 tbsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tinned crushed tomatoes100g cheddar, grated4 tbsp yellow mustardBrown the mince with half the onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick.Grill the franks until blistered.Fill the rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar, the rest of the onion and mustard.Porch board of beer nuts, jerky and picklesThe cabin's just a little dusty.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Cabin mainsWood chipper pulled pork rolls with slawMike dives into the wood chipper. Smoky pulled pork and apple slaw.How to make it1.5kg boneless pork shoulder2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml apple juice125ml barbecue sauce1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded1 green apple, cut in matchsticks3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp apple cider vinegar8 soft white rollsRub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and cook at 150°C until it falls apart.Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some of the juices.Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and vinegar.Pile the pork and slaw into the rolls.Beehive hot honey grilled chickenTucker saws into a beehive. Chargrilled thighs glazed in hot honey.How to make it1kg boneless chicken thighs2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp smoked paprika2 garlic cloves, crushed125ml honey2 tsp chilli flakes1 tbsp apple cider vinegar2 corn cobs20g butterToss the chicken with the oil, paprika, garlic and salt.Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and vinegar and set aside.Grill the chicken and corn over medium-high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.Brush the chicken with the hot honey for the last few minutes, butter the corn and serve.Campfire TreatsChamomile honey cake with whipped creamDale throws the chamomile tea at Chad. Tea-soaked honey cake.How to make it4 chamomile tea bags125ml boiling water125g butter, softened100g brown sugar125ml honey, plus extra to drizzle2 eggs200g self-raising flour300ml thickened creamSteep the tea bags in the boiling water for 10 minutes, then squeeze them out.Beat the butter, sugar and honey until pale, then beat in the eggs.Fold in the flour and the tea, pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170°C until a skewer comes out clean.Cool, then serve in wedges with whipped cream and more honey.From the eskyIce-cold Pabst Blue Ribbon cansThat's a PBR buddy. Cracked one each round the fire.How to make it8 x 355ml cans of Pabst Blue Ribbon beer2 bags of iceBury the cans in ice in the esky.Crack one each and pass them round the fire.Sweet iced tea by the jarSipped slow on the porch.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
